field_text_formatted.value: Core file fields let you choose a directory, and that setting takes tokens. Drupal ships [date:custom:Y]-[date:custom:m] as the default. What it can't take is a token about the entity you're attaching the file to, because at the moment the file is saved those values don't exist yet. The file name isn't touched at all.
